propositions: REBAR_LLM_MODEL is a scalar environment variable that provides an ambiguous second interface to model selection, superseded by per-class model configuration, and must be deprecated with a migration window rather than kept as a permanent alias.

The deprecation warning must be emitted at both env-read sites (config.py:469 and model_classes.py) to catch all code paths, with per-call emission semantics and no dedup machinery, and must not be placed in resolve_model_string where provenance is lost.
When REBAR_LLM_MODEL is set and no explicit class configuration exists, the variable must map to all three model classes (frontier, gateway, reflector) with the widest compatibility reading.

The deprecation must be registered in _deprecations.REGISTRY via _scheduled(...) with permanent=False and remove_in=_MAJOR (v1.0.0), not _permanent(...), because it is a supersession by a different interface rather than a rename.

User-facing documentation strings in argparse descriptions, MCP tool descriptions, and module docstrings must be updated to present class-based configuration as the current interface and mark REBAR_LLM_MODEL deprecated.

Example configurations for each provider (Anthropic-only, Bedrock-only, mixed-provider, local+fallback) must be shipped as complete [tool.rebar.llm.model_classes] tables in docs/ that operators can paste directly.
